_comment: QuickSight data source pointing at the reporting Postgres replica. Lives in a PRIVATE subnet (no public endpoint) reached via a QuickSight VPC connection; credentials come from Secrets Manager (CredentialPair is shown for shape but production should use SecretArn). Region pinned to me-central-1 (UAE/Dubai) for data residency (PROJECT_OVERVIEW.md). Shape matches: aws quicksight create-data-source.
Name: Suntech Reporting (Postgres replica)
